title: Sony Pulls Plug On Concord: Multiplayer Shooter Game Goes Offline Soon After Launch
description: Sony has decided to take its multiplayer shooter game Concord offline starting September 6, 2024, offering refunds to PS5 and PC players. The company stated that while many aspects of the game resonated with players, other aspects did not meet their intended launch goals.

title: Sony Becomes KADOKAWA's Largest Shareholder - What's On the Cards?
description: Sony has acquired a 10% stake in KADOKAWA, becoming the largest shareholder. The alliance aims to boost the global value of KADOKAWA's IP through joint projects in anime, live-action films, games, and virtual production.
